bots.name: Variance Explainer
bots.tagline: Computes the rate / volume / mix / funding NII bridge and writes commentary grounded only in those numbers.
bots.schedule: After each close + weekly ALCO flash

steps.label: Rate / volume / mix / funding NII bridge by portfolio
steps.sql:
SELECT portfolio,
  (act_avg_bal - bud_avg_bal) * bud_margin     AS volume_eff,
  (act_yield - bud_yield) * act_avg_bal        AS rate_eff,
  mix_eff, funding_eff, act_nii - bud_nii      AS nii_var
FROM SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.V_NII_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-09';
steps.result: NII £15.6M vs £16.2M budget · NIM 3.63% vs 3.91% · the gap is rate and funding, not volume

steps.label: Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ £0.1M)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.NII_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 1e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
steps.result: 5 drivers selected: asset yield, deposit beta on fixed-term bonds, bridging mix, volume ahead of plan

steps.label: AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
steps.result: Commentary drafted (176 words) · numeric check: 10/10 figures match the bridge

steps.label: Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
Draft commentary to Variance Analysis + cockpit
steps.sql: INSERT INTO SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('variance-analysis', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');
steps.result: Draft published (badge: Written by Variance Explainer)

guardrails.label: Grounding
guardrails.rule: Every figure in the text must exist in the bridge result

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Only drivers above threshold are explained

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.T_VARIANCE_EXPLAINER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
AS
  CALL SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('variance-explainer');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Rate / volume / mix / funding NII bridge by portfolio
SELECT portfolio,
  (act_avg_bal - bud_avg_bal) * bud_margin     AS volume_eff,
  (act_yield - bud_yield) * act_avg_bal        AS rate_eff,
  mix_eff, funding_eff, act_nii - bud_nii      AS nii_var
FROM SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.V_NII_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-09';
-- step 3 · Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ £0.1M)
SELECT * FROM SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.NII_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 1e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
-- step 4 · AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
SELECT AI_COMPLETE('claude-sonnet-4-5',
  'Write FP&A commentary using ONLY these figures: ' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::STRING)
FROM SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.NII_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5;
-- step 5 · Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
SELECT SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.FN_NUMBERS_GROUNDED(:commentary, 'NII_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5');
-- step 6 · Draft commentary to Variance Analysis + cockpit
INSERT INTO SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('variance-analysis', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');

bots.name: Rolling Forecast
bots.tagline: Retrains the ML balance forecast after close and rolls the 9+3 if accuracy holds.

steps.label: Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST: originations, redemptions, deposits
Roll forecast: actuals Jan–Sep + ML Oct–Dec

guardrails.label: Accuracy
guardrails.rule: Backtest MAPE must not exceed threshold

guardrails.label: Movement
guardrails.rule: FY change vs prior forecast above this needs approval

approval.title: Promote the 9+3 as current forecast
approval.detail: Actuals Jan–Sep plus the ML forecast for Oct–Dec. Backtest MAPE is 2.8%. FY PBT is £83.2M, driven by NIM compression and development-finance ECL (cost of risk 30 bps vs 15 bps plan).

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.T_ROLLING_FORECAST
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('rolling-forecast');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST: originations, redemptions, deposits
CREATE OR REPLACE SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.M_BALANCE_FC(
  INPUT_DATA => TABLE(SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.HTB_ML_HISTORY), SERIES_COLNAME => 'series',
  TIMESTAMP_COLNAME => 'month', TARGET_COLNAME => 'value');
-- step 3 · Guardrail: backtest MAPE ≤ 4%
CALL SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.M_BALANCE_FC!SHOW_EVALUATION_METRICS();
-- step 4 · Roll forecast: actuals Jan–Sep + ML Oct–Dec
CALL SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.SP_ROLL_FORECAST(source_version => 'BUDGET', new_version => 'FC_9_3', actual_through => '2026-09');
-- step 5 · Promote 9+3 to current forecast (approval)
CALL SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.SP_PROMOTE_VERSION('FC_9_3', approved_by => :approver);

steps.result: 7 new GL accounts (broker procuration fees + 2 ILTR collateral codes)

Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
steps.result: 5 auto-applied · 2 sent for review (broker fees: EIR-deferred or expensed?)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.MAP_ACCOUNT SELECT ... FROM SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Any account with balance above this goes to review

approval.detail: AI_CLASSIFY proposes deferring the fees into effective interest rate (EIR) income for bridging (confidence 0.83), consistent with the IFRS 9 EIR policy.

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.T_GL_MAPPER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/London'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('gl-mapper');

-- step 1 · Unmapped accounts detected
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 2 · AI_CLASSIFY against group COA
SELECT account_code, AI_CLASSIFY(account_name || ' ' || sample_postings,
  (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(label) FROM SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE is_leaf)) AS mapping
FROM SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 3 · Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
SELECT * FROM SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence < 0.92;
-- step 4 · Apply mappings + DMF on unmapped balance
INSERT INTO SDP_HTB.PUBLIC.MAP_ACCOUNT SELECT ... FROM SDP_HTB.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;
